latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Provides a comprehensive, game-theoretic auction bidding strategy framework for common auction formats.

- Supports English, Japanese, Vickrey, Dutch, and first-price sealed-bid auctions, with format-specific optimal bidding rules.
- Distinguishes between private value and common value auctions, including winner’s curse diagnostics.
- Guides users through context and input gathering: auction format, value classification, walkaway value, number of bidders, and more.
- Delivers explicit bid recommendations, underlying rationale, pitfalls to avoid, and seller-side format comparison notes.
- Intended for anyone preparing to bid or design auctions in business, procurement, real estate, M&A, and similar contexts.
- Excludes open-ended negotiations, combinatorial/package-bidding, and pure cost-estimation challenges.
